messages:
noah: Heads-up: were retiring the last Jenkins controller and moving CI to Buildkite + OIDC next week (2026-04-08 00:30-01:30 UTC). Please scan for Jenkins references and plan migrations.

noah: Key impacts: stop adding new Jenkins jobs, CODEOWNERS/status checks may need remapping, and long-lived tokens will be blocked after cutover.

amira: ack. Wheres the migration checklist?

noah: PLAT-8042 has the checklist. Short actions: convert top jobs, remove deploy keys, switch to OIDC role bindings, and update badges.

chris: Any automated tooling?

noah: We shipped `scripts/migrate/jenkins-to-buildkite.sh` and pipeline templates in `platform/buildkite-templates`. Its best-effort for simple Jenkinsfiles. Complex groovy needs manual work.

infra-oncall: Schedule: dry-run in staging 2026-04-07 22:30 UTC. Live cutover 04-08 00:30 UTC. We'll drain agents and requeue long jobs to Buildkite. Expect <20m disruption for a few long jobs.

security: Important: rotate OIDC provider certs 30m before cutover. After migration we will reject legacy tokens. If you still use deploy keys, rotate them now.

amira: How do I find repos using Jenkins shared libs?

noah: Try:
```bash
grep -R "infra/jenkins-shared" || true
grep -R "Jenkinsfile" --exclude-dir=node_modules || true
```

chris: What about status checks mapping?

noah: We will add provisional Buildkite contexts mapping to old Jenkins contexts during the window (`jenkins/ci` -> `buildkite/ci`). Still avoid merges during the cutover.

ops-bot: @channel Dry-run scheduled in staging 2026-04-07 22:30 UTC. Live cutover 2026-04-08 00:30 UTC.

ops-bot: Live cutover started at 00:30:12 UTC. Draining Jenkins agents.

ops-bot: Buildkite agents registered and pipelines queued at 00:41:05 UTC.

infra-oncall: Observed 2 canceled Jenkins jobs >30m; both re-ran OK in Buildkite. No auth regressions.

security: Sampled OIDC tokens verified. No legacy token traffic after cutover.

noah: Great job team. We'll keep the Jenkins controller read-only for 72h before full decommission. Post any issues here with build links.

amira: PRs merged to migrate 6 repos.

chris: Updated README badges and status contexts.

infra-oncall: All top pipelines green; marking PLAT-8042 resolved.

noah: Closing thread. :tada:
